基于改进SBR-YOLOv11n的受限空间火灾探测模型

李聪1,2(), 许文博1,2, 滕文飞1,2, 汪陈徽3, 吴建松2    

Fire detection model in confined space based on improved SBR-YOLOv11n

Li Cong1,2(), Xu Wenbo1,2, Teng Wenfei1,2, Wang Chenhui3, Wu Jiansong2    

RichHTML
0
PDF
0
摘要/Abstract

摘要：

针对受限空间火灾中火焰亮度低、目标小、易受干扰等问题,在YOLOv11n模型基础上,提出一种改进的受限空间火灾探测模型SBR-YOLOv11n。在骨干网络部分,将部分标准卷积层替换为空间深度转换卷积(SPDConv)层,解决模型在低亮度下火焰特征容易丢失的问题;在颈部网络部分,引入双向特征金字塔网络(BiFPN)模块,通过双向连接与可学习权重机制提升小目标火焰特征的融合效果;此外,采用倒置残差块注意力机制(iRMB),对动态火焰特征进行自适应加权,提高模型探测动态火焰的鲁棒性。结果表明:SBR-YOLOv11n模型各项评价指标达到最优,与YOLOv11n模型相比,精确率(P)、召回率(R)、平均精度均值(mAP@0.5和mAP@0.5:0.95)分别提升5.27%、3.81%、4.17%和3.03%,达到84.94%、83.83%、84.63%和62.97%,检测帧数(FPS)为75 帧/s。SBR-YOLOv11n模型满足受限空间火灾快速与精准探测需求,适用于受限空间火灾探测。

关键词: 受限空间, 火灾探测, SBR-YOLOv11n, 特征提取, 注意力机制

Abstract:

Aiming at the problems of low flame brightness, small target and easy interference in confined space fires, an improved confined space fire detection model SBR-YOLOv11n was proposed based on YOLOv11n model. In the backbone network part, some standard convolution layers were replaced by Space to Depth Convolution (SPDConv) layers to solve the problem that the flame features were easy to lose under low brightness. In the neck network part, the Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network (BiFPN) module was introduced to improve the fusion effect of small target flame features through bidirectional connections and learnable weight mechanisms. In addition, the Inverted Residual Mobile Block (iRMB) was used to adaptively weight the dynamic flame features to improve the robustness of the model to dynamic flame detection. Experimental results show that the SBR-YOLOv11n model has the best evaluation indexes. Compared with the YOLOv11n model, Precision (P), Recall (R), mean Average Precision (mAP@0.5) and mAP@0.5:0.95 are increase by 5.27 %, 3.81 %, 4.17 % and 3.03 % respectively, reaching 84.94 %, 83.83 %, 84.63 % and 62.97 %, with a detection speed of 75 Frames Per Second (FPS). The SBR-YOLOv11n model meets the needs of rapid and accurate fire detection in confined space and is suitable for fire detection in confined spaces.

Key words: confined space, fire detection, SPDConv-BiFPN-iRMB-YOLOv11n (SBR-YOLOv11n), feature extraction, attention mechanism

Title:	

Research on pore structure and gas desorption mechanism of bituminous coal by temperature and pressure coupling

摘要:	

为探明温压耦合作用下煤体孔隙结构与瓦斯解吸机制的关联,以鱼卡低渗烟煤为研究对象,结合低温氮气吸附、压汞实验、分形理论与Katz-Thompson模型,量化不同温压耦合条件下的孔隙结构与渗透率特征,并开展瓦斯解吸测试。研究结果表明:温压耦合作用下的孔隙响应具有阶段性特征。随着处理温度升高,3组压力下煤样的平均孔径增大,孔容和比表面积占比出现吸附孔衰减、渗流孔增大,总比表面积降低73.5%～87.1%,渗流孔分形维数下降3.3%～4.0%,累积解吸量和初始解吸速度分别增大28.9%～41.0%和37.3%～43.9%,其中2 MPa组煤样总孔容降低10.4%,Kseep提高20.3%,Ktotal降低14.5%,呈现出整体孔容减少、局部渗流输运能力增强的特征; 证明高压压缩并不必然导致多尺度孔隙的输运能力同步下降。研究结果可为解释带压热处理后煤样的孔隙变化与恒温解吸行为提供参考。


Abstract:	

In order to explore the relationship between coal pore structure and gas desorption mechanism under the temperature and pressure coupling,this paper takes Yuka low permeability bituminous coal as the research object,and combines low temperature nitrogen adsorption,mercury injection experiment,fractal theory and Katz-Thompson model to quantify the pore structure and permeability characteristics under different temperature and pressure coupling conditions,and carry out gas desorption test.The results show that the pore response under the action of temperature and pressure coupling has stage characteristics.With the increase of treatment temperature,the average pore size of coal samples under three groups of pressures increases,the proportion of pore volume and specific surface area shows the attenuation of adsorption pore and the increase of seepage pore.The total specific surface area decreases by 73.5%～87.1%,the fractal dimension of seepage pore decreases by 3.3%～4.0%,and the cumulative desorption amount and initial desorption rate increased by 28.9%～41.0% and 37.3%～43.9%,respectively.Among them,the total pore volume of coal samples in 2 MPa group decreases by 10.4%,Kseep increases by 20.3%,and Ktotal decreases by 14.5%,showing the characteristics of overall pore volume reduction and local seepage transport capacity enhancement.It is proved that high pressure compression does not necessarily lead to a simultaneous decrease in the transport capacity of multi-scale pores,which can provide a reference for explaining the pore change and constant temperature desorption behavior of coal samples after pressurized heat treatment.
